---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: '[feat] '
labels: enhancement

---

**Problem to solve**
What user need or pain point does this address?

**Proposed solution**
What should happen, described concretely (UI, API, or behavior).

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches you thought of, and why this one is better.

**Scope check**
- [ ] Frontend only
- [ ] Server/API only
- [ ] Both
- Rough size: tiny (<1h) / small (<3h) / medium (a day) / large (multi-day)
